findings: Upstream per-interface beacon update selects target BSS and BCN then BMC queue through FQCR0, polls BUSY and aborts submission on timeout
Upstream SN_VALID is cleared for non-QoS-data/non-BAR frames in this builder, including ordinary beacon; upstream does not demonstrate a unique software beacon SN cookie
Upstream TxS uses WCID+PID lookup, separate ownership architecture; not evidence vendor PID reuse or late report contract is safe
Per-BSS checked queue flush is a candidate mechanism to compare register bits, but does not itself prove host Rx/late-report drain
